newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse unit to launch CBS TeleNoticias in US.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse unit to launch CBS TeleNoticias in US.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS TeleNoticias Monday said it will launch a U.S. network on March 17.
The 24-hour, the Spanish-language news network, will originate from CBS TeleNoticias' broadcast center in Miami.

CBS TeleNoticias said its U.S. network will share many anchors and correspondents seen on the Latin American network. The network is already distributed to 10 million households in 18 countries and territories in Latin America as well as in Spain and the United States, the company said.
Separately, CBS TeleNoticias said it has reached a carriage agreement with Medcom Holdings to launch on Cable Onda and Telemetro in Panama beginning the first week in March.

Cable Onda, the largest cable operator in Panama, will offer CBS TeleNoticias to its 25,000 subscribers. In addition, the 24-hour Spanish-language news network will have partial carriage on broadcast television in Panama via Telemetro which reaches over 600,000 subscribers.
Terms of the agreements were not disclosed.
